DeckardScrollOfIdentify.name: Scroll of Identify
DeckardScrollOfIdentify.description: Quest: Hitting an enemy Hero with Scroll of Sealing permanently increases its damage by 2. Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, Scroll of Sealing reveals and reduces the Armor of Heroes hit by 10 for 4 seconds. Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, this talent's Armor reduction effect is

DeckardFieldStudy.name: Field Study
DeckardFieldStudy.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Scroll of Sealing grants 20% Spell Power for 16 seconds, up to 40%.

DeckardGemSapphire.name: Sapphire
DeckardGemSapphire.description: Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100% and its slow by 30%. Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

DeckardPotionOfShielding.name: Potion of Shielding
DeckardPotionOfShielding.description: Whenever an ally is healed by a Healing Potion, they gain a 140 Shield for 6 seconds.

DeckardRejuvenationPotion.name: Rejuvenation Potion
DeckardRejuvenationPotion.description: Healing Potions restore 15 Mana and heal for an additional 114 over 3 seconds.

DeckardGemRuby.name: Ruby
DeckardGemRuby.description: Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100% and it spawns 3 Lesser Healing Potions from each enemy Hero hit, healing allied Heroes for 250 when picked up. Lesser Healing Potions last for 10 seconds. Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

DeckardCubeMastery.name: Cube Mastery
DeckardCubeMastery.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Scroll of Sealing from 40 to 25. Each enemy Hero hit by Horadric Cube reduces the cooldown of Scroll of Sealing by 4 seconds.

DeckardKanaisCube.name: Kanai's Cube
DeckardKanaisCube.description: Horadric Cube reduces Hero damage dealt by 30% for 4 seconds.

DeckardGemEmerald.name: Emerald
DeckardGemEmerald.description: Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100% and have it reduce the healing received of enemy Heroes by 75% for 4 seconds. Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

DeckardStayAWhileAndListen.name: Stay Awhile and Listen
DeckardStayAWhileAndListen.description: After 1 second, Channel for 3 seconds, putting enemy Heroes in front of Deckard to Sleep while Channeling, and for 2 seconds after. Enemies can only be put to Sleep once per cast, and Sleep's effects end instantly if they take damage.

DeckardLorenado.name: Lorenado
DeckardLorenado.description: Vector Targeting After 1 second, create a twirling tome tornado that travels towards the targeted direction, continually knocking away enemies that come into contact with it. Deals 20 damage to Heroes hit.

DeckardSuperHealingPotion.name: Super Healing Potion
DeckardSuperHealingPotion.description: If a Healing Potion isn't picked up for at least 2 seconds, it heals for 100% more. Passive: Healing Potion heals for 25% more when the target is under 50% health.

DeckardPotionOfRevival.name: Potion of Revival
DeckardPotionOfRevival.description: When a Healing Potion is picked up, it also heals all nearby allied Heroes for 75% of the healing amount.

DeckardAncientBlessings.name: Ancient Blessings
DeckardAncientBlessings.description: Activate Fortitude of the Faithful to empower nearby allied Hero Basic Attacks for 8 seconds, causing them to deal an additional 62 damage in an area and heal for 90 for each Hero hit. This effect can only occur once per second.

DeckardScrollOfStoneCurse.name: Scroll of Stone Curse
DeckardScrollOfStoneCurse.description: Scroll of Sealing deals 200% more damage when hitting at least 2 Heroes.

DeckardSafetyInNumbers.name: Safety in Numbers
DeckardSafetyInNumbers.description: If at least 2 allied Heroes are nearby, Fortitude of the Faithful grants an additional 10 Armor, 50% Mana Regeneration per second, and causes Deckard's Basic Abilities to recharge an additional 50% faster.

DeckardHoradricStaff.name: Horadric Staff
DeckardHoradricStaff.description: Every 5 seconds, Deckard's next Basic Attack Stuns Heroes for 0.75 seconds.

DeckardRespectTheElderly.name: Respect the Elderly
DeckardRespectTheElderly.description: Stay Awhile and Listen Silences and Blinds enemies for 3 seconds upon waking up from Sleep.

DeckardMorenados.name: Morenados!
DeckardMorenados.description: Lorenado gains an additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds every time an enemy Hero is knocked back. This effect can only occur once per 0.5 seconds.

DeckardBottomlessFlask.name: Bottomless Flask
DeckardBottomlessFlask.description: After use, Healing Potions recharge after 8 seconds.

DeckardPerfectGems.name: Perfect Gems
DeckardPerfectGems.description: Reduce the cooldown of all Gems to 5 seconds and the cooldown of Horadric Cube by 6 seconds.
